rule: WordPress theme CSS leaks into React app -- must use #root scoping and display:none on .site-header .site-footer .entry-title
reason: SS design system had invisible theme elements overlaying React content. Fix: important: '#root' in tailwind.config + CSS overrides in index.css

rule: Stitch rewrites copy on every generation -- always compare output text against spec before accepting
reason: Stitch optimises for visual balance not content accuracy. Lost pricing and dates in SS Live rebuild.

rule: Text contrast must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 body 3:1 large). Test: #D2D2D2 on #0C0322 = 11.8:1 PASS. #9CA3AF on #0C0322 = 7.2:1 PASS.
reason: Legal requirement. SS tertiary text (#9CA3AF) on dark bg still passes but is the floor.

rule: CTA buttons must contrast against their section background by at least 3:1. Gold #FBBF24 on #0C0322 = 12.6:1.
reason: Low-contrast CTAs kill conversion. SS gold on purple-dark is the benchmark.

rule: Always use display=swap in Google Fonts URL. Fallback stack must include system-ui.
reason: FOIT (flash of invisible text) on slow connections. Both SS and Databrill systems use display=swap.

rule: Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Buttons py-3 px-6 minimum. Links in nav need adequate spacing.
reason: Failed usability test on SS mobile nav with small tap targets.

rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Databrill has useReducedMotion hook. Disable parallax and auto-play for motion-sensitive users.
reason: Legal accessibility requirement. Databrill already implements this.

rule: WP Rocket defers JS via lazy load -- needs user interaction to trigger. Test pages with JS disabled to check above-fold content.
reason: SS Live 2026 page was blank until scroll on first load. WP Rocket conflict.

rule: Never leave an odd card in a grid. 2-col needs even count. 3-col needs multiple of 3. One orphan card looks broken.
reason: SS Live 2026 spec rule. Orphan cards create visual imbalance.

rule: Sections need py-16 md:py-24 minimum (SS) or py-32 (Databrill Stitch). Cramped sections feel cheap.
reason: Both design systems use generous section padding as a premium signal.

rule: Card backgrounds must be fully opaque (#2F0453 or #1A1A1A) when cards overlap or fan — never use rgba/translucent backgrounds in stacked layouts
reason: Text bleed from fanned cards behind makes content unreadable. Discovered in CardStack carousel build.

rule: Use semantic landmark roles: main nav header footer aside. Screen readers use these for page navigation. Every page needs at least main.
reason: Screen reader users navigate by landmarks. Without them the page is a flat wall of content.

rule: First focusable element should be a 'Skip to main content' link. Visible on focus hidden otherwise.
reason: Keyboard users shouldn't have to tab through 20 nav links to reach content.

rule: Headings must follow h1 > h2 > h3 order. Never skip levels (h1 then h3). One h1 per page.
reason: Screen readers build a document outline from headings. Skipped levels break navigation.

rule: Labels above inputs (not beside or inside as placeholder). Required fields marked with asterisk (*) plus legend.
reason: Labels-as-placeholders disappear on focus — user forgets what field is for. Beside-labels slow scanning.

rule: Don't use color alone to convey information. Add icons text or patterns alongside color coding.
reason: 8% of men are color-blind. Red/green error/success coloring fails without icons or text labels.

rule: Errors must be announced to screen readers. Use role='alert' or aria-live='assertive' on error containers.
reason: Screen reader users don't see visual error styling. Without announcement they don't know something failed.
